gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2; Chronic Kidney Disease

candidate_evidence.quote: We are doing this study to learn more about how semaglutide may help fight chronic kidney disease in people with type 2 diabetes.

role_evidence.quote: Once-weekly (OW) Semaglutide administered subcutaneously (s.c., under the skin).

agents.drug_class_hint: GLP-1 receptor agonist, antidiabetic (tested for diabetic CKD, not cancer)

role_evidence.quote: Once-weekly (OW) placebo (Semaglutide) administered subcutaneously (s.c., under the skin).

coder_notes: Not a cancer trial: type 2 diabetes with chronic kidney disease; 'glomerular basement membrane' outcome only. Semaglutide is the only investigational agent in the experimental arm but has no antitumour purpose, so has_eligible_candidate false. Control is a registered PLACEBO_COMPARATOR, so control_arm_from_other_arms no.
